item.title: Bedbugs, cockroaches at closed Porterville care home may push Tulare County to seek Newsom's help
item.description: Dozens of documented complaints, including bedbug and cockroach infestations at a now-closed residential care facility in Porterville, may prompt the Tulare County Board of Supervisors to send a letter to Governor Newsom for help.

item.title: Central Valley Dance Festival to focus on hope and suicide awareness
item.description: This year, the Central Valley Dance Festival wants to shine a light on the topic of suicide. The message: The Power of Hope.

item.title: Good Sports: Retired Merced County judge still serving on the tennis court at 86
item.description: Now at 86 years old, Robert Quall has won 17 Gold Balls, the prize for taking first at a national tournament.

item.title: Firefighters respond to second fire this month caused by children
item.description: The Fresno Fire Department is asking parents to be on alert after the second blaze this month, caused by children playing with fire.

item.title: Man accused of poisoning Southern California couple by spraying bug spray on food
item.description: A couple is speaking out after their roommate allegedly poisoned them, leading to a standoff with deputies. Video shows the man spraying bug spray on their groceries.

item.title: EXCLUSIVE VIDEO: Suspect orders victim to drive him to attempted Madera jewelry store robbery
item.description: A Madera man is now behind bars after a bizarre carjacking in broad daylight on Sunday.

item.title: Students design Madera Unified Autism Acceptance Month t-shirt
item.description: Madera Unified is preparing now for Autism Acceptance Month, which takes place in April.

item.title: Disaster as fencing wire gets tangled in spinning car wash in North Carolina
item.description: The first rule of going to the car wash with your truck is make sure there's nothing in the bed. A North Carolina man found that out the hard way.

item.title: 2026 CIF Central Section High School Basketball championships at Selland Arena
item.description: Downtown Fresno is buzzing with action on the court. The 2026 CIF Central Section High School Basketball Finals are happening this weekend at Selland Arena.

item.title: Israel's defense minister says his country has attacked Iran and declares a state of emergency
item.description: Israel launched a daylight attack Saturday on Iran's capital, with a cloud of smoke rising from the city's downtown.
